summary: AEC TV Online reported that on the morning of July 2 the Royal Thai Armed Forces led the ASEAN Observer Team-Thailand to Trat province. The delegation began at Ban Hat Lek permanent checkpoint, inspected the area around boundary marker 73 and a nearby sediment-control dam built by a Cambodian private entity, and later received briefings on recovered landmines along the Trat border.

title: Neighbours swap citizens
summary: Inkl republishes Bangkok Post reporting that authorities repatriated 36 Thai nationals from Cambodia and returned 67 Cambodian nationals through Khlong Luek under bilateral legal and humanitarian cooperation. The 67 Cambodians had completed legal proceedings and served their sentences in Thailand.

title: President Xi Jinping Meets with Prime Minister of Thailand Anutin Charnvirakul
summary: China's Foreign Ministry reported that President Xi Jinping met Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul in Shanghai on July 17. Xi said peaceful handling of the Thailand-Cambodia border dispute served both countries' long-term interests, urged dialogue and consultation, and said China was ready to continue playing a constructive role. Anutin said Thailand remained committed to peaceful resolution and appreciated China's role.

title: President Xi Jinping Meets with Prime Minister of Cambodia Hun Manet
summary: China's Foreign Ministry reported that President Xi Jinping met Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet in Shanghai on July 17. Xi said consolidating the ceasefire and gradually rebuilding trust served Cambodia and Thailand's long-term interests, supported a solution through dialogue and negotiation, and said China was ready to continue playing a positive role. Hun Manet said Cambodia remained committed to dialogue, negotiation and de-escalation.
